notes: Recorded live 2026-11-15 (no session). The cart BFF answers every cookie-less request with a bare HTTP 400 (empty body) — real and nonexistent paths alike — so the 400 proves the base URL + session gate, not the path; path + method + body come from Migros's public JS bundles (see account.py). Mutating verbs without a session hang (WAF tarpit). The order BFF answers user-scoped paths with HTTP 401. Any request to migros.com.tr carrying a Cookie header hangs from this sandbox (even the public homepage with a junk cookie) — authed behaviour needs the owner's own smoke test.
